guard: the real CLI loads a native fault preload through an encoded file URL on every platform

mutations.name: native fault preload is passed as a filesystem specifier
mutations.expectRed: a live unpopulated roster is partial with ROSTER_INCOMPLETE and exit 4
mutations.cell: a live unpopulated roster is partial with ROSTER_INCOMPLETE and exit 4

why: The real preload path contains spaces and a fragment delimiter, so the native CLI child must load it through a file URL. Its trace and live broker result establish that the hook ran. No compiled package is mutated.
